# Component catalog coverage

This table records the official shadcn main component catalog retrieved on
2026-08-09 and the corresponding `spfx-react17-base-nova-v1` support decision.
Included components retain the official Base UI Nova default classes, semantic
tokens, variants, composition, and behavior. The package applies only the
React 17, scoped CSS, portal, ID, and versioned Base UI compatibility adjustments
identified in `catalog.json`; it does not redesign, retheme, or substitute
project-specific visuals.
